Dash_Subtitle: Live overview of your Wi-Fi gateway
Dash_HintStopped: Connect the Ethernet cable, review Network & Wi-Fi, then press Start.
Users_Subtitle: Accounts that can sign in on the portal
Field_PasswordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password
Plans_Subtitle: Bundles of limits you assign to accounts and guests
Net_Subtitle: Where internet comes from and how your Wi-Fi looks
Net_WanHint: Pick the Ethernet connection that has internet. Wi-Fi clients get internet through it.
Net_OpenWarning: Windows Mobile Hotspot always requires a WPA2 password (8+ characters). AeroGate keeps the network protected; share the Wi-Fi password publicly (sign or QR code) and control access with portal accounts.
Net_Isolate: Block Wi-Fi clients from this PC's own services
Net_IsolateHint: Protects shared folders, local web servers, remote desktop, etc. on this computer.
Net_RestartNotice: The gateway is running — network changes apply the next time it starts.
Sites_BlockHint: The sites below are blocked; everything else works.
Sites_AllowHint: Only the sites below open after sign-in; everything else is blocked.
Sites_Syntax: One site per line. example.com = exactly that name. *.example.com = the domain and every subdomain (www, m, cdn…).
Plans_UseVpnHint: Sends this plan's traffic through the VPN port set on the Network page (when the VPN applies to selected plans).
Vpn_CoreReady: Xray core is ready next to the app (core\xray.exe).
Vpn_CoreMissing: Xray core is missing — reinstall AeroGate Pilot so the core folder is present.
Vpn_Import: Paste share links (vless://, vmess://, trojan://, ss://)
Vpn_PingTcpOnly: Server answers — {0} ms (TCP). Use Ping for a full Xray test.
Vpn_CoreNote: AeroGate starts Xray itself from your link — no Clash/v2rayN port needed. Pick the server with the best ping, Save, then Start gateway.
Vpn_Enable: Send users' traffic through a VPN port on this PC
Vpn_Hint: Run your VPN app (v2rayN, Clash, Nekoray, Hiddify…) with its local proxy port on, then enter that port here.
Vpn_PresetPick: Pick an app to fill in its port…
Vpn_Fallback: Connect directly when the VPN is down
Vpn_Note: Web and app connections (TCP) go through the VPN. DNS and other UDP traffic stay direct; QUIC is turned off so browsers use the VPN.
Portal_Subtitle: The page people see when they join your Wi-Fi
Field_LangSwitch: Show language switch on the page
Portal_CssHint: Added after the built-in styles, so you can override anything (e.g. .card { border-radius: 8px; }).
Portal_TemplateHint: Export the built-in HTML/CSS/JS, edit the files in the folder and AeroGate uses them automatically. Placeholders like {{title}} and {{t.sign_in}} are filled in for you.
Portal_TemplateCustom: Custom template files are in use.
Portal_PreviewHint: Preview runs on this PC only; signing in is disabled there.
Diag_Subtitle: Checks that this PC can act as a Wi-Fi gateway
Diag_AboutText: AeroGate Pilot turns a Windows PC with Ethernet internet into a Wi-Fi hotspot with a login page, per-user data/time/speed limits and live monitoring.
Msg_PasswordRequired: Enter a password for the new account.
Msg_PlanInUse: Accounts still use this plan. Move them to another plan first.
Msg_InvalidSsid: The Wi-Fi name must be 1–32 characters.
Msg_InvalidPassphrase: The Wi-Fi password must be 8–63 characters.
Msg_InvalidPort: The portal port must be between 1024 and 65535.
Msg_InvalidVpn: Enter the VPN address and port (for example 127.0.0.1 and 10808).
Msg_InvalidRelayPort: The relay port must be between 1024 and 65535 and differ from the portal port.
Msg_AllowListEmpty: Add at least one site to the list, or choose "All sites".
Msg_ImportEmpty: No valid share link found. Paste a vless://, vmess://, trojan:// or ss:// link.
Msg_CoreMissing: Xray core (core\xray.exe) is missing. Reinstall AeroGate Pilot.
Msg_NoServer: Import and select a server link first.
Msg_Stopping: Stopping the gateway and restoring network settings…
Msg_TemplateExported: Template exported. Edit the files in the folder that just opened.
